newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Batelco seen posting 27 mln dinar net in 96.
newsitem.headline: Batelco seen posting 27 mln dinar net in 96.

text.p: Bahrain Telecommunications Co (Batelco) is forecast to post a 27 million dinar ($71.55 million) net profit in 1996, up from 25.8 million dinars in 1995, the Securities & Investment Research Co said.

"Batelco continues to conduct broadband network service trials. The need for higher bandwidth is growing, especially with the continued evolution of multimedia applications," the research company said.
Batelco said earlier this year it would spend 100 million dinars over the next five years to enhance its network. The research company said this was positive, but would reduce Batelco's liquidity.
The Bahraini government owns a 39 percent stake in Batelco and Cable and Wireless Plc of Britain holds 20 percent. The rest is owned by investors and financial institutions.
